schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE INDEX idx_combined ON Communication(comm_action, comm_channelid)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP ({row_count}) 'Action_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) % 10, REPLICATE('A', 100) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
